_comment: Copy to hosts.json and edit. hosts.json holds plaintext credentials: keep it out of git, readable only by you. Every key under `defaults` may be overridden per host.
_auth: Use `password` or `keyFile` (optionally `passphrase`) - exactly one. `keyFile` wins if both are set. ssh-hop refuses to start while the REPLACE_ME password or the example key path is still here, so an unedited copy fails loudly instead of mysteriously.
_commands: allowCommands/denyCommands are Python regexes matched with re.search against the whole command; DOTALL is on, so `.` spans newlines. "*" (or "") allows everything. denyCommands wins over allowCommands. Default is ["*"], i.e. nothing is restricted.

ubuntu-01.desc: Ubuntu 22.04 app server; docker compose stack under /opt/app
ubuntu-01._note: Full shell access: anything is allowed, including writes and sudo.

db-01.desc: Database box; only postgres tooling plus read-only shell basics
db-01._note: Narrow example: the first allow rule that matches wins, so list specific rules before broad ones.

openwrt-r2._note: No blanket "*" rule here, so only the listed commands run.
